tei:div.tei:p: Fortunate are they that dwell in Thine House, they will still praise Thee, Selah. Fortunate the people to whom this happens, fortunate the people whose God is the Lord.

I exalt Thee, my God and King, and bless Thy Name for ever and ever. Every day do I bless Thee and praise Thy Name for ever and ever. Great is the Lord and highly to be praised, His greatness is unfathomable. Generation shall praise Thy works to generation and they shall tell of Thy mighty deeds. The beauty of the glory of Thy majesty and
words about Thy wonders shall I utter. Men shall speak of the strength of Thine awe-inspiring deeds and, as for Thy greatness, let me relate it. The fame of the abundance of Thy goodness do they express and exult in Thy righteousness. Gracious and compassionate is the Lord, long suffering and great in kindness. Benevolent is the Lord towards all and His compassion is upon all His creatures. All Thy works acknowledge Thee, O Lord, and Thy pious ones bless Thee. They speak of the glory of Thy dominion and tell of Thy might to make known to the sons of man His mighty deeds and the glory of the beauty of His dominion. Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom and Thy dominion is in every generation. The Lord supports all that fall and straightens all that are bent. All eyes hope for Thee and Thou givest them their food in its time. Thou openest Thy hands and satisfiest all the living in favour. Righteous is the Lord in all His ways and pious in all His deeds. The Lord is near all who call Him, all who call Him in truth. The desire of those that fear Him does He do and He hears their cry and saves them. The Lord protects all that love Him and destroys all the wicked. The fame of the Lord does my mouth declare and all flesh shall bless His holy Name for ever and ever. We too shall bless the Lord from now to eternity. Halleluyah.
